text: nina: quick thread about tooltip microcopy + focus behavior on prompt-set eval results. dropped a prototype in figma: https://www.figma.com/file/newtooltips/proto samir: skimmed. microcopy feels terse. current tooltip says "More info" when you hover a failed regression example. i'd prefer something more specific like "Why this regressed" or "Example diff details". kelly: agree. Also need to think about what screen readers hear. Tooltips are often invisible to SR users unless we mirror content into a live region or aria-describedby. jordan: impl constraints: we can't render long explanatory text inside every cell because of perf. propose concise tooltip text + a link "Read details" that opens the expanded panel. nina: proposed copy options: - short: "Why this regressed" - descriptive: "Regression summary: lower score than baseline" - action: "See example and trace" thoughts? samir: vote for short + action link. Short keeps visual density, link gives access to full context for those who need it. kelly: accessibility notes: - tooltip must appear on focus as well as hover - tooltip element should be referenced via aria-describedby from the trigger - if the link opens a panel, ensure focus moves into the panel and that panel has role=dialog or region with labelledby - do not rely on title attribute, it's not keyboard friendly jordan: code sketch suggestion: ``` Why this regressed. Read details ``` ensure tooltip is removed from tab order but text is available via aria-describedby. samir: SR flow: when the panel opens, announce context: "Opened regression detail for example 7, 2 input-output pairs. Press escape to close." Use an aria-live polite update when results update. kelly: focus management: when opening panel from tooltip link, move focus to first interactive within panel. on close, return focus to original trigger. write unit test for that. nina: mobile behavior: tooltips should degrade to an inline accordion or small modal. hover is meaningless on touch; tapping should open the panel directly. keep touch targets >=44px. jordan: performance: virtualize the list of result cells; render tooltip content lazily only when hovered/focused or tapped. don't attach listeners to hundreds of nodes synchronously. samir: microcopy for link text: prefer "View details" over "Read details" because some panels include interactive controls, not just reading. kelly: a11y-bot suggestion: ensure tooltip contrast meets 3:1 against background; if using semi-transparent surfaces, add a subtle border for separation. a11y-bot: accessibility-scan: prototype pass except missing keyboard-visible focus style on small chips and missing aria-describedby on a couple triggers flagged on page. nina: analytics: track events `tooltip.open`, `tooltip.link_click` with properties `example_id`, `prompt_set`, `device_type`. jordan: tests: unit test for tooltip visibility on focus, e2e for panel focus trap + restore, and a screen reader smoke test to ensure aria-describedby reads the tooltip on focus. samir: copy final suggestion: tooltip title: "Why this example regressed" visible line; body: "Dropped accuracy vs baseline." link text: "View details" (opens panel). aria-label on open button: "Open details for example ". kelly: i'll update figma and push a PR with the aria attributes + lazy load + tests. tagging @samir @jordan for review. thanks :sparkles: a11y-bot: scheduled re-scan on PR branch. report due after CI completes.
